payload.summary: A strong feeling finds one concrete action before it scatters into frustration.
payload.body: A strong feeling finds one concrete action before it scatters into frustration. Mars sextile Neptune can turn grief, outrage, hope, or creative urgency into a fundraiser, volunteer shift, performance, or direct request that gives people somewhere useful to put their energy. The action does not have to solve the entire problem to matter. It needs a clear purpose and a person who can receive the help. Choose the next task people can actually complete, then let the larger feeling stay larger than the assignment.
